title.zh-TW: 註冊成功獲得 NT$80 優惠回饋
title.en: NT$80 in rewards on signing up

text.zh-TW: 取自平台分享文案；實際內容、金額與期限以官方公告為準。
text.en: From the platform's share text; actual terms follow the official announcements.

title.zh-TW: 完成首次活動後，推薦人獲得 NT$80
title.en: Referrer gets NT$80 after your first activity

text.zh-TW: 取自平台分享文案；實際內容、金額與期限以官方公告為準。
text.en: From the platform's share text; actual terms follow the official announcements.

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟專屬邀請連結（邀請碼 E3xNJQM5w8 已包含在連結中）。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the personal invite link (invite code E3xNJQM5w8 is already part of it).

steps.zh-TW: 使用該連結完成 Klook 註冊；若註冊時要求邀請碼，請輸入 E3xNJQM5w8。
steps.en: Complete your Klook registration through that link; if it asks for an invite code, enter E3xNJQM5w8.

steps.zh-TW: 依活動規則領取 NT$80 優惠回饋；完成首次活動後，推薦人也會獲得 NT$80。
steps.en: Receive the NT$80 reward under the campaign rules; after your first activity the referrer gets NT$80 too.

intro.zh-TW: 使用邀請碼 E3xNJQM5w8 註冊 Klook：新朋友可獲得 NT$80 優惠回饋，完成首次活動後推薦人也可獲得 NT$80。
intro.en: Sign up for Klook with invite code E3xNJQM5w8: you get NT$80 in rewards, and the referrer gets NT$80 after your first activity.

description.zh-TW: Klook 客路是可預訂旅遊體驗與活動的平台。本頁的連結是專屬邀請連結，邀請碼 E3xNJQM5w8 已包含在連結中；若註冊時要求輸入邀請碼，請依原樣輸入並注意大小寫。依分享文案，新朋友註冊後可獲得 NT$80 優惠回饋，完成首次活動後推薦人也可獲得 NT$80；實際條件與期限以官方公告為準。
description.en: Klook is a platform for booking travel experiences and activities. The link on this page is a personal invite link and invite code E3xNJQM5w8 is already part of it; if the sign-up asks for an invite code, enter it exactly as shown, including capitalization. According to the platform's share text, you receive NT$80 in rewards after signing up, and the referrer gets NT$80 after your first activity. Actual terms and deadlines follow the official announcements.

notes.zh-TW: 邀請碼 E3xNJQM5w8 已包含在連結中；手動輸入時請依原樣（含大小寫）。優惠回饋的使用條件與期限以 Klook 官方說明為準。
notes.en: Invite code E3xNJQM5w8 is already part of the link; if you type it in, enter it exactly as shown, including capitalization. Conditions and deadlines for the rewards follow Klook's official terms.
